name: print-social-flavors-and-fillings-cake-cross-section-collage-post
title: Four macro cake cross-sections around a sticker cake with a cream arc footer
whatItIs: A 4:5 post with a 2x2 grid of close-up cake layer photos, a gingham cake on a stand cutout with a cream halo in the centre, a bold blue outlined title 'Flavors & Fillings', and a cream arc at the bottom holding a call to action.
whatItMeans: Mouth-watering and playful; macro layers create texture and the sticker cake is the anchor.
techniques: Use macro layer photos as a textured backdrop.
Overlay a sticker-outlined cutout at the centre.
Set the title with a cream outline.
End with a shallow arc footer.

vocabulary.definition: A cutout with a thick outline.
A curved panel at the bottom.
